title: Introduction and overview — A-6 Intruder
description: Introduction and overview of the A-6 Intruder: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The A-6 Intruder is a twin-engine carrier-based attack aircraft built by Grumman, entering service in 1963. Its advanced (for the era) digital navigation and attack radar let it strike at night and in all weather. 693 were built; Intruders flew heavy combat in Vietnam and Desert Storm before retirement in 1997. Baseline facts: Carrier-based all-weather attack aircraft; service 1963-1997; 693 built by Grumman..
